subject: Business Models
title: Churn Rate
description: Learn Churn Rate in one minute.

hook.text: If 5% of subscribers cancel each month, you lose half your customer base in a year.

buildup.text: Churn rate measures the percentage of subscribers who cancel in a given period. It compounds devastatingly.

discovery.text: Even a 1% difference in monthly churn changes outcomes dramatically over time. Small leaks sink ships.

twist.text: Netflix's monthly churn is under 2%. Most consumer subscriptions run 5-7%. That gap is worth billions.

climax.text: Reducing churn by 1% often generates more revenue than acquiring thousands of new subscribers.

punchline.text: Churn compounds monthly. A 1% difference creates or destroys empires.

quiz.question: Why is reducing churn often more valuable than acquiring new subscribers?

details.summary: Churn rate measures the percentage of subscribers who cancel within a given period. A 5% monthly churn means losing 5 out of every 100 subscribers each month. Even small differences in churn compound dramatically over time, making retention the most critical lever in subscription economics.
details.whyItMatters: Churn is the silent killer of subscription businesses. A business acquiring 100 customers monthly with 5% churn plateaus at 2,000 subscribers. At 3% churn it plateaus at 3,333..
takeaways: Even small reductions in churn compound into massive revenue differences
Monthly churn above 5% makes sustainable growth nearly impossible in B2C
Involuntary churn from failed payments can represent 20-40% of total churn

faq.question: What is a good churn rate for subscription businesses?
faq.answer: Enterprise SaaS targets below 1% monthly churn. SMB SaaS targets 2-3% monthly. Consumer subscriptions typically see 5-10% monthly churn. Streaming services average 3-5% monthly. Lower churn always indicates a more sustainable business, and rates vary significantly by segment.

faq.question: What are proven strategies for reducing subscription churn?
faq.answer: Improve onboarding to drive early value realization. Send engagement-based retention campaigns before cancellation risk peaks. Offer pause or downgrade options instead of full cancellation. Fix payment failures with retry logic and card updaters..
